== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Wagg Spiritspeak]] ([[Ferndale]])
* [[Reisen the Phoenix]] (only during [[Raid on Kaineng Center]])
* [[Hamato]] ([[The Undercity (Winds of Change)]] (only during [[When Kappa Attack (Hard mode)]]))

== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes will use this skill upon entering combat, however, they will not recast it unless they have moved out of spirit range or if all the spirits have died.
* Because the attack range of the summoned spirits is significantly smaller than spirit range, this may lead to situations where the spirits are too far from enemies to attack, yet the Hero will refrain from recasting them unless the aforementioned conditions are met.

== Notes ==
* This skill summons a [[Spirit of Anger]], a [[Spirit of Hate]] and a [[Spirit of Suffering]]. These spirits use the [[Pain (attack) (Signet of Spirits)|Pain attack skill]].
* This skill triggers effects of skills like [[Boon of Creation]], [[Spirit's Gift]] and [[Explosive Growth]] on all three spirits.
* Combines with [[Feast of Souls]] for a cheap powerful party heal.
* Combines well with [[Shaman's Insignia]] for +15 armor rating.

== Trivia ==     
* During [[The Tengu Accords]], [[Master Togo]] summons the same three spirits with [[Call to the Spirit Realm]].
<!-- This trivia has been confirmed by Linsey Murdock. Do not remove it. -->
* The three spirits are inspired by a quote from [[w:Yoda|Yoda]] in Star Wars: ''“Fear is the path to the dark side. Fear leads to anger. Anger leads to hate. Hate leads to suffering.”'' <ref name="Linsey confirms Yoda's influence">[http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=User_talk:Linsey_Murdock&diff=1620226&oldid=1620209 Linsey confirms Yoda's influence.]</ref>
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Signet of Spirits/Skill history|PvE]] and [[Signet of Spirits (PvP)/Skill history|PvP]] skill revision history for details.
* This is the only player-usable, non-[[ritual]] skill that creates spirits.
